shared.<shared#27>: Replace an exact original line span inside one public workspace file. Engineering only. The span must equal expected_text exactly, expected_text must occur exactly once in the file, and expected_digest (the read_range file content_hash) must still match when given; otherwise the edit is rejected and the file is left unchanged. Requires an accepted engineering plan for the current effective contract, and the path must be inside that plan's scope.
shared.<shared#28>: Engineering-only: run one project-registered command in the run workspace with a stripped environment, time limit, output limit, and process-tree cleanup. Only the registered name and allowlisted extra args are accepted. The host-observed exit status is the evidence; a self-reported exit_code is never read. run_command results are action receipts and cannot be listed in submit_delivery check_names; run the checks a delivery needs with run_check.

<shared#29>.description: Submit an engineering plan before changing delivery files. The host binds it to the current effective contract. Plan adjustments require a reason; product requirements must be decided by product.
